minor_findings.summary: The non-procedural recipe description is omitted.
minor_findings.evidence: The YAML describes the recipe as a dense compact flow modeled after the original RecipeFlow notation; the candidate retains title and yield but has no description field.

rationale: The omitted descriptive sentence does not alter cooking meaning; every ingredient, setup prerequisite, operation, dependency, bake condition, completion test, and final output remains faithful.
